GenAiPlugin.description: This topic handles the invocation of different agents based on the user's query. It ensures that the appropriate agent is engaged depending on the nature of the user's request. Normally any question related to appointment scheduling or HCP care plan generation related or knowledge based related questions like how to do , why this is happening , asking anything about vaccine or disease related questions should invoke this topic

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the user's query pertains to knowledge management or scheduling related like appointment scheduling or request for HCP care plan generation .
Please use the action CallAgentBasedonUserQuery and pass the user input to the action to receive agent response.

If user is asking for Appointment scheduling and he has provided HCP details already in the previous step , please consider HCP details along with the other scheduling details while trying to schedule the appointment .

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to determine the nature of the user's query and invoke the relevant agent to handle the specific request. You should not attempt to resolve the query yourself but rather facilitate the connection to the appropriate agent.
